title: Leptirica
review: A pretty terrible early attempt at horror from Yugoslavia, about a hairy-faced vampire who terrorises a farm. Being as the reveal of who the vampire is comes right at the end, it was probably a mistake to put their face in vampiric form on the poster. The location and costumes are good, but in most other ways it is not enjoyable as a modern viewer. There is no focus on characters or meaning in the plot, and it's just a depiction of events without personality.
